To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the capacity region of an AV-MACS can be increased significantly by allowing conferencing and that this increase can be discontinuous.
(1) conferencing is necessary for positive rates in arbitrarily varying multiple-access channel, and (2) conferencing is not always helpful in arbitrarily varying multiple access channel.
the capacity region of an AV-MC with conferencing is equal to either the 2-D or 0-D random coding region, and that the latter is strictly smaller than the former.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the capacity region of an arbitrarily varying multiple-access channel with conferencing encodings.
arbitrarily varying multiple-access channel models in which the transmitters are allowed to cooperate by communicating with one another.
the capacity region of the arbitrarily varying multiple-access channel (AV-MAC) with conferencing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the capacity region of an AV-MACS with conferencing encorders equals the 2-dimensional capacity region, if the channel's deterministic coding capacity region is zero.
, if conferencing is not possible, the capacity region of an AV-MACS is always zero, and if conferencing is available, then the capacity region can be positive.

the capacity regions of AV-MACs with conferencing encorders are determined by the 2-D capacity region and the 1-D deterministic capacity region, and that the former is either zero or equals the latter.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the capacity of an AV-Mac with a conferencing encoder is the maximum of the capacity without conferencing and the 2-D capacity.
conferencing can increase the capacity region of the arbitrarily varying multiple-access channel, but it is not always necessary.
the capacity region of an AV-MAX is the union over all deterministic capacity regions, and the 2-D capacity region if the 2-D region is not contained in this union.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, unlike compound MACs, the capacity region of an AV-MC may increase discontinuously when conferencing is enabled.
conferencing can increase the capacity region even if it is not possible to achieve any positive rates without conferencing.
conferencing can increase capacity, even in arbitrarily varying channels, but only when the channel is not arbitrarily varying in all directions.
